items.title: Optimization Strategies for Read-Heavy Workloads
items.objective: Understand and apply optimization strategies for read-heavy workloads using caching mechanisms.
items.why_included: The learner scored 0.0% in this domain and incorrectly selected a multi-AZ deployment instead of caching with Amazon ElastiCache (evidence: 82f62179-e77c-4646-a328-0d4e540e9cc1).

items.title: Choosing the Right NoSQL Database
items.objective: Identify and select appropriate NoSQL database services for low-latency access.
subtopics: Use cases for Amazon DynamoDB vs. Amazon Aurora
items.why_included: The learner misidentified the appropriate NoSQL database service for low-latency access, choosing Amazon Aurora instead of Amazon DynamoDB (evidence: ad89a225-6d70-4fe8-9afb-9e84c6df8eee).

items.title: Effective Fault Tolerance Strategies for Multi-Tier Applications
items.objective: Explore and implement effective fault tolerance strategies for multi-tier applications using multiple Availability Zones.
items.why_included: The learner confuses effective fault tolerance strategies for multi-tier applications, opting for a single Availability Zone instead of utilizing Elastic Load Balancing across multiple zones (evidence: 685889ef-cdaa-4c8b-9e8e-6d3db2b14497).
